setup.text: Chop the coriander and pudina (a handful of each).

operations.label: slice thick
operations.text: Slice the tomatoes thick.

operations.label: soak 20 min
operations.text: Soak the rice for 20 minutes.

operations.label: whip smooth
operations.text: Whip the curd until smooth.

operations.label: blend to a paste
operations.text: Blend the Kashmiri red chillies into a paste.

operations.label: cook partially
operations.text: Cook the rice partially in a pot of water with a little salt, a little coriander and pudina, and the tablespoon of oil.

operations.label: heat in a thick-based pot
operations.text: In a thick-based pot, heat the oil.

operations.label: add
operations.text: Add the cardamom, cloves, bay leaves and cinnamon.

operations.label: sauté 3 min, until onions start to brown
operations.text: Throw in half the onions and sauté with the ginger garlic paste for 3 minutes, or until the onions start to brown.

operations.label: add
operations.text: Add the chilli paste and the remaining onions.

operations.label: sauté until golden brown
operations.text: Sauté until golden brown.

operations.label: add
operations.text: Add the coriander, pudina and lemon juice.

operations.label: sauté
operations.text: Add the tomatoes and the whipped curd, and sauté.

operations.label: sauté until oil separates
operations.text: Add the salt and sauté until the oil separates.

operations.label: cook covered, low flame, 10 min
operations.text: Throw in the meat and let it cook covered on a low flame for 10 minutes.

operations.label: cook 30 min, until oil separates
operations.text: Add the water and cook for 30 minutes, until the oil separates.

operations.label: spread over the meat
operations.text: Add the rice over the meat.

operations.label: top
operations.text: Top with a little coriander and pudina.

operations.label: drizzle on top
operations.text: Drizzle the ghee on top.

operations.label: cover, simmer 15 min
operations.text: Cover and let it simmer for 15 minutes.

operations.label: heat off, rest 10 min
operations.text: Turn off the heat and let it rest for 10 minutes.

operations.label: mix well, serve
operations.text: Mix well and serve!
